test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

1, 2, 4, 4, 9, 6, ?, 8, 25, 10
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **(Number)², Number×2, and so on with increasing numbers after each loop.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7206b068a11e3542fc295112d7090d13f20d2b8f8c5c69c565123b8feed577a.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
